source_title: George Cheeks Unveils Skydance TV Leadership Team Across Studios, Sports, Entertainment & News
source_excerpt:
HBO’s ‘Big Little Lies’ Kicks Off Production On Season 3, Sort Of
Paramount+ Names Damla Dogan As Unscripted Chief
Channing Dungey To Oversee Warner Bros. International TV Production As Division Moves Under Skydance TV Studios
George Cheeks has revealed his leadership team.
Skydance TV’s Co-Chair and Chief Content Officer Cheeks has named his 10 top executives across the company’s studios business, entertainment, sports and news.
This includes the creation of Skydance TV Studios, which will officially house Warner Bros Television Group, run by Channing Dungey; CBS Studios, run by David Stapf; and Paramount Television Studios, run by Matt Thunell. On the CBS Studios front, See It Now Studios will operate as a label within the studio, similar to what the company did with BET Studios. Susan Zirinsky, President of See It Now Studios, reports to Stapf.
George Cheeks Teases Skydance TV Strategy In Memo To Staff, Exalts CBS, Sports & News
Skydance Putting All 3 TV Studios Under George Cheeks: Warner Bros. TV, CBS Studios, PTVS – The Dish
Skydance TV Studios also will include Skydance Sports Entertainment. It comes after Jesse Sisgold, who previously was President and COO of Skydance Media and more recently ran Paramount Sports Entertainment, revealed he is leaving the company . Watch on Deadline
David Berson will lead Skydance’s Global Sports Group, Amy Reisenbach leads CBS Entertainment, and Tom Cibrowski runs news operations. As previously announced, Bari Weiss, editor-in-chief of CBS News, reports directly to Skydance co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz.
Bryon Rubin has been named COO and will expand his remit to oversee CBS Television Stations group, working with division president Jennifer Mitchell.
Laurel Weir will oversee research and programming insights across Skydance TV broadcast, cable and studios. Mike Benson will lead marketing across the company’s portfolio. Chris Ender will oversee all communications and publicity.
These execs all report directly to Cheeks.
“As we look to the future, our priorities are clear: deliver great storytelling, maximize the value of our programming, franchises and brands and strengthen our connection with audiences, Cheeks wrote in a memo seen by Deadline (read it in full below). “The excellence and scale of our entertainment, news and sports businesses, combined with the talent and expertise across our organization, position us well for the road ahead.”
Team, As we look to the future, our priorities are clear: deliver great storytelling, maximize the value of our programming, franchises and brands and strengthen our connection with audiences. The excellence and scale of our entertainment, news and sports businesses, combined with the talent and expertise across our organization, position us well for the road ahead. While each of us has a distinct role to play, our success will depend on all of us working together at every level, sharing expertise and leveraging the full strength of our portfolio. I’m a firm believer that a collaborative culture generates strong creative and business results. Today, I’m excited to announce the Skydance TV leadership team. Reporting to me, these accomplished leaders will work together to advance our strategy and help shape the next chapter of our division. Skydance TV Studios Channing Dungey will continue to lead the Warner Bros. Television Group and its portfolio of scripted, unscripted and animation studios. Warner Bros. TV Studios is home to the Emmy Award-winning series THE PITT and an impressive slate of acclaimed series. She will also oversee the combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery cable roster of 50+ brands such as HGTV, Food Network, TNT, BET and MTV. For cable channels outside the U.S., Channing will report to me for programming and to JB Perrette for operations. David Stapf will continue to lead CBS Studios , which is home to NCIS, the world’s #1 television franchise, including the recently launched NCIS: NEW YORK, the #1 new series of the broadcast season. The Studio also produces hits such as SHERIFF COUNTRY and popular streaming series like “Little House on the Prairie” and “Murderbot.” See It Now Studios will operate as a label within CBS Studios. Matt Thunell oversees Paramount Television Studios , home to premium series for streaming and broadcast, with blockbuster franchises including “Reacher,” its spin-off “Neagley” and the Taylor Sheridan universe that spans DUTTON RANCH, LANDMAN and LIONESS on Paramount+ and MARSHALS on CBS. Skydance Sports Entertainment will be part of the Skydance TV Studios Group with details to follow. Global Sports Group David Berson leads Skydance’s Global Sports Group , with oversight of our live sports portfolio, led by CBS Sports, TNT Sports and WBD Sports, across all platforms and in partnership with JB and the International team for outside the U.S. Combined sports rights for the new division include the NFL, UEFA Champions League, NHL, MLB, March Madness, PGA Tour, The Masters, WNBA, NASCAR and college football, among many others. Entertainment Amy Reisenbach leads CBS Entertainment , a cornerstone of our multiplatform strategy and home to the most-watched primetime schedule on television that consistently delivers the biggest new hits year after year – including this season’s Rotten Tomatoes 100% Certified Fresh drama CUPERTINO. News Tom Cibrowski will continue to oversee operations across CBS News’ broadcast, streaming and digital businesses, while leaning into his deep experience in morning television to bolster CBS MORNINGS , and sustain the ratings momentum at CBS EVENING NEWS . Skydance TV The following leaders will support our broader Skydance TV organization as we bring together and grow our group: Bryon Rubin will be our Chief Operating Officer (COO) working with all divisional leaders on strategic and operational matters while maintaining his leadership of CBS’ domestic syndication. Bryon will expand his remit to include oversight of the CBS Television Stations group, working closely with division president Jennifer Mitchell, who will also have a dotted reporting line into me and will be part of my Skydance TV SLT. Laurel Weir will oversee research and programming insights across Skydance TV broadcast, cable and studios. She will work closely with creative and marketing leaders in all areas to help shape our strategy through a deep understanding of audience insights and consumption trends. Laurel will continue to oversee her content strategy, scheduling and content acquisitions teams for the Paramount cable networks while we work through integration planning. Mike Benson will lead marketing across our portfolio, bringing our talented teams together to strengthen our brands, elevate audience discovery and eventize and promote our programming launches through all forms of traditional and emerging media. Mike will have a dotted reporting line to Rebecca Mall, Chief Marketing Officer, Skydance. Chris Ender will oversee all communications and publicity. He will serve as the spokesperson for Skydance TV and lead best-in-class comms teams in each division that will shape our narrative, elevate brands and programming and help define the voice of our combined group. Chris will have a dotted reporting line to Melissa Zukerman, Chief Communications Officer, Skydance, and support JB Perrette on any Skydance TV business and operations topics. What happens next I know many of you have questions about our structure and what comes next. We will continue to share more information when possible. We’re still early in this journey and process, but I’m confident in the strength of this team and in the extraordinary talent and capabilities across our business. As I’ve said, the work ahead is significant, and so is the opportunity. Together, we’ll build on our strengths and shape an even stronger future. Thank you for everything you do. More to come. George
